buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder must have a PAN Card and must upload Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the last three financial years (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). 2. The bidder must upload the GST Registration Certificate and GST Returns for the last three financial years (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). 3. The bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 53,28,000 or more in the last three fina ncial years (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). Proof: Turnover Certificate certified by a Chartered Accounta nt bearing UDIN No., OR Balance Sheet with Profit and Loss Account statement bearing UDIN No. 4. The bidder must have a minimum of 5 years of experience in cleaning, upkeep and laundry services of h ospitals. Documentary evidence must be uploaded. 5. The bidder must be registered with the Labour Department. The registration certificate must be uploade d. 6. The bidder must have its own office / workshop, adequately trained manpower and equipment related to laundry services. Documentary evidence and photographs must be uploaded. 7. The bidder must upload the details of the manpower to be deployed for the work, along with the CV of e ach person.

8. The bidder must submit a Technical Plan describing how the work will be executed, including the numbe r of persons required, their category, shift-wise deployment, and the step-by-step plan of execution. 9. The bidder must have a service centre within 25 km, or must submit a declaration on Rs 100 stamp pap er that an office will be opened within one month from the date of receipt of the order. 10. The bidder must submit a declaration on Rs 100 stamp paper that whenever replacement of manpower is required, a replacement will be provided within 2 to 3 hours, or as early as the Service Provider is able to do so. 11. The bidder must submit an affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper, notarised, stating that the Service Provider Agency is not a family member or close relative of any officer / employee of the Medical Health and Family Welfare Department. 12. The bidder must submit an affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper, notarised, stating that it has not been black listed / debarred by any department, that no court case is pending against it, and that all information and documents uploaded are correct. 13. EMD of Rs 1,06,560 is required, payable in favour of Chief Medical Officer Jhansi. The EMD must be upl oaded on GeM and the original must be submitted in the office of the Chief Medical Officer, Jhansi within 5 working days from the date of opening of the technical bid. 14. The selected firm must deposit Performance Security equal to 5% of the project value in the form of Ba nk Security, in the name of Chief Medical Officer, Jhansi, along with the contract agreement. 15. The Service Provider must deploy at each CHC 3 Sanitation Workers (in three shifts), 1 Gardener and 1 Laundry Worker, a total of 5 personnel on roster basis. All materials used in the work must be arranged by the Service Provider. 16. Wages to skilled / unskilled workers must not be paid below the minimum wages prescribed by the Lab our Department, U.P. in Government Orders issued from time to time. The Service Provider must pay all ot her statutory dues as applicable. 17. The decision of the Bid Committee at every stage will be final and acceptable to all bidders. 18. In case of any dispute, the judicial jurisdiction will be District Jhansi. 19. The guidelines (norms) for Financial Year 2026-27 have not yet been received. As soon as they are rec eived, the terms and conditions of this bid will be amended accordingly. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
